paper_title: 2-Tier SimCSE Elevating BERT for Robust Sentence Embeddings
caption: : Figure 2: Accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase sentiment, and STS tasks.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of accuracy and correlation scores across several models, labeled along the horizontal axis as "Single-task_baseline," "Baseline_with_Adaptive_Dropout," "Unsupervised_SimCSE," "Supervised_SimCSE," and "2-Tier SimCSE." The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy / Correlation" and displays values on a linear scale from 0 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. Each model is represented by three bars, colored yellow, pink, and light blue, corresponding to "Sentiment Acc.," "STS Corr.," and "Paraphrase Acc." respectively, as indicated in the legend. The "Single-task_baseline" model exhibits the shortest bars, with approximate values of 0.52 for Sentiment Accuracy, 0.58 for STS Correlation, and 0.75 for Paraphrase Accuracy. The "2-Tier SimCSE" model has the tallest bars, with approximate values of 0.79 for Sentiment Accuracy, 0.78 for STS Correlation, and 0.76 for Paraphrase Accuracy. The bars for each model are grouped together, allowing for a visual comparison of the three metrics within each model. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
